tweetHighlights.originalBody:
Much respect to @tokengobbler who shutdown Vibe-kanban live onstage at AIE Europe - still with 30,000 MAU, and still living on as an open source project.

"Everyone who is making money is doing 2 things: selling to enterprise, and reselling tokens. We were doing neither." 

surprisingly not the first company to shutter at AIE but there's a lot to learn from the process and the software engineering retrospective from 2021-2025 will stick in my mind!
tweetHighlights.translatedTitle: 向 @tokengobbler 致敬，他在 AIE Europe 的舞台上现场关闭了 Vibe-kanban -…
tweetHighlights.translatedBody:
向 @tokengobbler 致敬，他在 AIE 欧洲大会上当场关闭了 Vibe-kanban——尽管它仍然拥有 3 万月活跃用户，并且仍然作为一个开源项目存在。

“所有赚钱的人都在做两件事：向企业销售产品，以及转售代币。而我们两件事都没做。”

令人惊讶的是，Vibe-kanban 并非 AIE 大会上第一个倒闭的公司，但这个过程有很多值得学习的地方，2021-2025 年的软件工程回顾将永远铭刻在我的记忆中！

tweetHighlights.originalTitle: Too many funds are capping downside right now, instead of maximizing upside..
tweetHighlights.originalBody:
Too many funds are capping downside right now, instead of maximizing upside..

I’ll often ask the GP/partner on why they did the deal and on my fifth why the real reason comes out which is “well at least big token factory will acquire them so our downside is capped”

I haven’t done this for many years but I don’t think history shows that’s how you return a 5-10x fund?

Maybe, the incentives have really simply shifted to AUM-maxxing and so the sentiment is deploy baby deploy. But, sigh, that just seems so incredibly short sighted. 

Maybe, it’s been a long day and I just want to rant but time is the only thing you don’t get back. Use it very wisely to work on things that matter and with people who won’t treat you as an option call 🫡
tweetHighlights.translatedTitle: 目前太多基金都在限制下行风险，而不是最大化上行收益。
tweetHighlights.translatedBody:
现在太多基金都在限制下行风险，而不是最大化上行收益。

我经常会问普通合伙人/合伙人为什么做这笔交易，但往往问到第五次的时候，他们才会说出真正的理由：“至少大型代币工厂会收购他们，这样我们的下行风险就被限制住了。”

我已经很多年没这么做了，但我认为历史经验表明，这种方法并不能让基金获得 5-10 倍的回报。

也许，激励机制真的只是单纯地转向了资产管理规模最大化，所以大家的想法就是“赶紧部署”。唉，这看起来真是目光短浅。

也许，今天太累了，我只是想发泄一下，但时间是唯一一去不复返的东西。好好利用时间，去做真正重要的事情，和那些不会把你当成期权筹码的人在一起。🫡

tweetHighlights.originalTitle: If you think AI replaces software engineers, here’s a quick thought experiment.
tweetHighlights.originalBody:
If you think AI replaces software engineers, here’s a quick thought experiment. 

Imagine you’re a life sciences company. 10 years ago you want to invest heavily in lab automation, processing data at scale, and other software. You look at the cost of doing so and realize you can’t compete with tech for as many engineers as you need, so you pare down your goals and do what you can. Every new software project has a fixed cost of a certain sized team, so you can only do so much given budgets, ability to compete for talent, and other trade offs.

Now, AI comes along. And all of a sudden you have the *exact same* output tokens as the best tech companies in the world. Your engineers are using the same AI models as the tech industry, which means you have just boosted your engineering team by a some meaningful amount, while also neutralizing your differences with tech. 

Do you continue with your pared down approach, or do you start to hire more engineers because each engineer is 2X or 5X more capable than before? In almost every company I’m talking to, they’re doing the latter.

Now extrapolate this to every bank, manufacturer, industrial company, retailer, and on and on. And extrapolate it not to just large enterprises, but also every SMB up and down the stack of these value chains. Oh, and also extrapolate this to other job functions, not just engineers. Resource scarce domains in marketing, legal, finance, design, and so on. 

If you’re wondering why new jobs show up because of AI this is the reason. Any other view of what happens doesn’t contemplate the variety of unmet needs there are in the economy.
tweetHighlights.translatedTitle: 如果你认为人工智能会取代软件工程师，这里有一个简单的思维实验。
tweetHighlights.translatedBody:
如果你认为人工智能会取代软件工程师，不妨做一个简单的思维实验。

假设你是一家生命科学公司。十年前，你计划大力投资实验室自动化、大规模数据处理以及其他软件。你评估了成本，发现无法与科技公司竞争所需的工程师数量，于是缩减了目标，力求做到力所能及。每个新的软件项目都需要一定规模的团队，因此在预算、人才竞争能力和其他权衡因素的限制下，你的能力也有限。

现在，人工智能出现了。突然之间，你拥有了与世界顶级科技公司*完全相同*的产出。你的工程师正在使用与科技行业相同的人工智能模型，这意味着你的工程团队实力得到了显著提升，同时也消除了你与科技公司之间的差距。

你会继续沿用之前的精简策略，还是会因为每位工程师的能力都比以前提升了2倍甚至5倍而开始招聘更多工程师呢？在我接触过的几乎所有公司里，他们都在做后一种情况。

现在，把这种情况推广到每一家银行、制造商、工业公司、零售商等等。而且，不仅要推广到大型企业，还要推广到价值链上下游的每一家中小企业。哦，还要推广到其他职能部门，而不仅仅是工程师。比如市场营销、法律、金融、设计等资源稀缺的领域。

如果你想知道为什么人工智能会催生新的工作岗位，这就是原因。任何其他解释都忽略了经济中存在的各种未被满足的需求。
